description: This file defines default event configurations, utility functions for event handling, and related types for an event scheduling feature in a TypeScript project.

methods.name: getDynamicEventDescription
methods.description: Generates a description string for a dynamic event with specified usernames and slug.

methods.name: getDynamicEventName
methods.description: Generates a name for a dynamic event with specified usernames and slug.

methods.name: getDefaultEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a default event object matching the given slug or returns a fallback.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Concatenates a list of usernames into a single string separated by commas.

methods.name: getUsernameSlugLink
methods.description: Constructs a URL slug link based on user list and event slug.

methods.name: arrayCast
methods.description: Ensures a value is returned as an array, wrapping it if necessary.

methods.name: getUsernameList
methods.description: Converts a string or array of strings into a sanitized list of username slugs.
